_note: Shipped device-safety guardrail. Merge the `permissions.deny` list below into the agent
harness settings (for Claude Code, `.claude/settings.json`). It is a deny list of spellings
and is best effort: it covers only what it enumerates, because a pattern list cannot express
'everything except two URL forms' across every shell and quoting style. The enforceable allow
list lives where the argument is parsed: the flash planner accepts only socket://127.0.0.1:*
and rfc2217://127.0.0.1:* as a port before any process is spawned.
Spellings that appear in argument position rather than at the head of the command line - a
virtual-environment python.exe path, a \\.\COM* device path, a /dev/cu.* path - cannot be
written as command-prefix matchers at all; the planner's allow list is what stops those.
